name: test.control.nonterminal
description: Live-test helper variant of test.control that is non-terminal by definition.

toolCallTerminalFlag.description: Optional strict-boolean override inside tool-call args that can mark this tool call as terminal (true) or non-terminal (false).

override.description: Value returned as tool_type_response_override_terminal (strict booleans are honored; non-booleans are ignored by the tool loop).
